name: Oldtown
description: The oldest and second largest city in Westeros, a center of knowledge, faith, and maritime trade. Home of the Citadel and the Starry Sept.

timeline.event: Aegon I is crowned in Oldtown by the High Septon, confirming it as the spiritual heart of the realm.

narratorText: Oldtown is a beautiful city of cobbled streets, stone bridges, and ancient buildings. It hosts the Citadel, where maesters train, and serves as the seat of the High Septon before King's Landing rises.

name: Lannisport
description: A bustling, wealthy port city situated just south of Casterly Rock, famous for its craftsmen, gold trade, and powerful Lannister garrison.

timeline.event: Lannisport resumes gold shipments under royal Aegon peace.

narratorText: Lannisport is one of the largest ports in Westeros, protected by stout stone walls. Its gold-smiths and glass-makers produce goods prized across the Narrow Sea.

name: White Harbor
description: The North's primary city and port, clean and well-ordered, built of white stone on the banks of the Outer Harbor.

timeline.event: White Harbor handles silver and timber exports for Winterfell.

narratorText: White Harbor was built by House Manderly when they were given the lands. It is a vital gateway for southern trade, keeping the North supplied with wine, oil, and iron.

name: Gulltown
description: A wealthy merchant city situated on the Bay of Crabs, acting as the primary window of the Vale to the rest of the world.

timeline.event: Gulltown harbor expands shipping lanes to Bravos.

narratorText: Sworn to House Grafton, Gulltown is a key trading hub. During the Conquest, a naval battle was fought in its harbor, resulting in the destruction of the Targaryen fleet and the death of Daemon Velaryon.

name: Planky Town
description: A floating merchant town at the mouth of the Greenblood river, where houseboats and rafts are tied together to form a colorful marketplace.

timeline.event: Planky Town trades with Free Cities, bypassing Targaryen waters.

narratorText: Planky Town is Dorne's gateway to the world. Orphans of the Greenblood navigate their barges here to sell spices, citrus fruits, and fine silk to foreign merchants.

name: Barrowton
description: A large town built around the Great Barrow of the First Kings, ruled by House Dustin.

timeline.event: Barrowton levies swear fealty to the Starks.

narratorText: Barrowton is a unique northern town with wooden streets and houses clustered around a colossal earthen hill where ancient kings are said to sleep.

name: Stoney Sept
description: A prosperous walled market town in the southern Riverlands, named for its massive stone sept.

timeline.event: Stoney Sept submits to Targaryen control.

narratorText: Stoney Sept is a major trade crossroads in the heart of the Riverlands. Its stone walls and towering sept make it a local fortress.

name: Duskendale
description: An ancient port town on the Narrow Sea, ruled by House Rykker, serving as a vital anchorage for coastal shipping.

timeline.event: Duskendale yields to Targaryen rule during initial conquest.

narratorText: Prior to the rise of King's Landing, Duskendale was the primary port on the Blackwater bay, generating immense customs revenue from seafaring trade.

name: Maidenpool
description: An ancient walled town on the southern shores of the Bay of Crabs, ruled by House Mooton and famous for Jonquil's Pool.

timeline.event: House Mooton submits to Aegon I.

narratorText: Maidenpool is named for Jonquil's Pool, where the legendary Jonquil was found bathing by Florian the Fool. It is a vital hub for fishing and trade.

name: Saltpans
description: A small port town at the mouth of the Trident, famous for its salt pans which supply the Riverlands.

timeline.event: Saltpans ships salt and salted fish to King's Landing.

narratorText: Saltpans is critical for preserving food in Westeros. Its shallow evaporative pans create high-quality salt traded far and wide.

name: Lord Harroway's Town
description: A town located where the Kingsroad crosses the Trident via ferry, named for the ancient House Harroway.

timeline.event: Harroway ferry resumes normal operations under Tully control.

narratorText: Lord Harroway's Town is a crucial bottleneck on the Kingsroad. It sits on low ground and is subject to frequent flooding when the Trident rises.
